author: A 🖤
text: All 4 kids have gift exchanges in their classes and the teachers requested we send little gifts for their “stockings” for 23-26 students. Times that by 4, that’s roughly $120-$140 and that’s if I go to the dollar tree. Everything isn’t even $1 anymore there. 😅😅😅😅😅😅😅🙃

topReplies.author: A 🖤
topReplies.text: Didn’t know this would get so much attention. Please be nice to me. I’m getting candy canes 😅💕

topReplies.author: A 🖤
topReplies.text: I have to mute this because it’s overstimulating 😅 thank you everyone who was nice and helpful! To those who weren’t, have the day yall deserve 💕🫶🏼

topReplies.author: TheGullibleSkeptic
topReplies.text: This is craaaaaazy. Why does each kid need to receive 26 random “stocking stuffers” chosen by people who don’t know them at all?

topReplies.author: A 🖤
topReplies.text: That’s what I wanna know. 🫠🫠 I know my kids don’t need that stuff lol.

topReplies.author: Lorien
topReplies.text: They need to eliminate that practice, it doesn't belong in the schools.

topReplies.author: A 🖤
topReplies.text: I agree. This is a first for our school

topReplies.author: Kat ☀️
topReplies.text: They should tell you about this shit at the beginning of the year so you can prepare wtf

topReplies.author: A 🖤
topReplies.text: I know!! My son gave me his paper today and the stuff is “due” Wednesday 🥲

topReplies.author: no refined suga
topReplies.text: That is horrible. As a parent I do not want more plastic crap around! So many other ways to celebrate the season.
